sentences.text:
This application coming on for orders this day, th e c
 following:
 Order

This is first application under section 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of regular bail in connection with crime No. 29/2024 registered at P.S. Sanawad, District Khargone for the offence punishable under sections 376(1), 450 and 506 of IPC.
2.
It is alleged that applicant had entered the house of the prosecutrix and committed rape with her by pressing her mouth.
3. Counsel for applicant submits that incident is said to have taken place on 27.1.2024 and FIR was registered on 30.1.2024.
It is further argued that in her statement under section 164 Cr.P.C., the prosecutrix has not made any allegation of rape against the applicant.
She is a major lady aged about 32 years.

sentences.text: 4. Counsel for the State opposes the prayer for grant of bail by submitting that prosecutrix in her statement under section 164 Cr.P.C. has made allegation of rape, however she could not dispute the fact that in the statement under section 164 Cr.P.C. she has not made any allegation of rape.
5. Taking into consideration the aforesaid submission and the statement of proseuctrix under section 164 Cr.P.C., I am of the view that the applicant is entitled for grant of bail.

Therefore,
without expressing any view on the merits of the case, the application is allowed.

6. It is directed that Applicant- Dhannalal shall be released from custody upon furnishing a personal bond of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) with one surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the court below.
A typed copy of this order is being forwarded to the Office of the Advocate General, on their email address, for intimation to the Police Station concerned.
The office is requested to forward a copy of this order to the court below.
